observed_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((originating_voice_type = ANY (ARRAY['exegete_own_view'::text, 'unattributed_group'::text])) AND (originating_voice_name IS NULL)) OR ((originating_voice_type <> ALL (ARRAY['exegete_own_view'::text, 'unattributed_group'::text])) AND (originating_voice_name IS NOT NULL))))

decisions.hold: No existing voice enum precisely represents an unnamed originator of unspecified number. Qila does not establish a group.
rejected_shortcuts: Do not assign Ibn Jarir as named originator.
Do not use exegete_own_view for Ibn Kathir.
Do not infer multiple people merely to fit unattributed_group.
Do not invent an unnamed person as a non-null name to satisfy a named enum.

decisions.scope: Own comment that Ibn Jarir mentioned the three views, not an assertion that Ibn Jarir originated or endorsed each.

schema_resolution: Keep anonymous provenance explicit in staging and leave voice mapping unresolved. A schema change requires separate justified design and existing authorized migration workflow; none is proposed or executed here.
next_step: Draft bounded A03 propositions/evidence with explicit unresolved anonymous voice hold and complete authorial reporting voice. Validate that no group, name or endorsement is fabricated.
